paper_id: Enhancing the Spatial Awareness Capability of Multi-Modal Large Language Model
title: Enhancing the Spatial Awareness Capability of Multi-Modal Large Language Model
motivation: 现有MLLM空间感知能力显著落后于人类需求，无法满足自动驾驶等高要求场景
problem_framing: MLLM缺乏精确空间信息，将多模态任务解耦为几何定位+语义关系+LLM推理三阶段
key_insight: 利用预训练小模型(Faster R-CNN+PSG)提供精确几何位置和场景图信息引导LLM
method_signature: 目标实体提取→目标检测获取几何坐标→场景图生成获取语义关系→Prompt引导LLM
evaluation_criteria: MME位置任务准确率、MM-Vet空间感知任务得分
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: "there is no gold standard, and no one is perfect; present MLLM struggles to effectively accomplish all multi-modal tasks with its intrinsic abilities alone"
evidence_for_taste: "present MLLM struggles to effectively accomplish all multi-modal tasks"
"there is no gold standard, and no one is perfect"
"current performance of MLLM in spatial awareness still significantly lags behind"
"This is the first work to combine pretrained smaller models with MLLM"
The improvement from fusion was 2.9% higher than cumulative improvements from using two pieces separately
thinking_moves: MLLM自身能力不足时求助于外部预训练小模型而非继续挖掘LLM潜力
将空间感知问题解构为几何定位与语义关系两层信息
验证融合效果时关注增量是否大于各部分增量之和以证明组合优势
承认MLLM内在局限而非强行提升模型规模或数据量
